sourceSentences: [0] raan feels like a very unfair Champion to play against IMO he can hit a Q and heal as ADC he can W in and E out and be gone
[0] so in Lane he feels like a wall this is a weird wall he feels like like um a fortress um between you and their ADC the lane is pretty much a stalemate nothing much happens
[0] you know if he hits a good W you can lanter your ADC away if he engages on you you can Flay him and get the Aftershock and trade
[0] I think it's a pretty 50/50 Lane so I'm going to put it in skill matchup

[1] So, bum would be top of A because Bum excels at using his passive to disrupt me, but Rakan can jump in and out and so we're going to be more fluid uh in skirmishes and we're going to be able to get through lane really easily as well.

[1] Where would a Blitzcrank like hook champs like Thresh and Blitzcrank go? Yeah, that would probably be Yeah, Blitzcrank probably top of B. Thresh. Actually, we'll put Thresh in A and then B for for Blitzcrank.
[2] Reactive matchup, you cant be proactive at all. If he whiffs E your window is open
[2] Whoever goes in first loses. It's like this for most engage supports. If you dash in first they will cancel your knock up. If they dash in first your peeling can counter them really well.

[2] Thresh can hook you but you can usually e away, back to your adc. Dodging his hook is easy if you have your adc near you. His flay can mess up your engage but overall he isnt a hard matchup as long as you dodge the hook.
[2] Same as NautiBoi. His hook can cancel your knockup. His hook is for a lot longer than Nautilus' though. Aside from that, he is not much of an issue.
[2] As long as you peel for your ADC, thresh will not be much of a problem. Just remember a Thresh is still a Thresh he will punish you if you engage him.
[2] Overall this match-up is very boring as you won't be able to do much to engage very well in the early game.
[2] thresh can with her ability set easily counter Rakan abilities making you cant engage easily on the line phase.
[3] Good engage-disengage so try to calculate your hooks to the enemy adc as he will jump to him/her after engaging you
[3] Rakan is very slippery so try to aim your hooks almost exclusively on the enemy adc as he might dash into your hook. Try to time your flay to cancel his dash away if you hook him.
[3] skill matchup, you can cancel his w but only before he has reached his destination
[3] When timed perfectly you can cancel his W but it is hard to punish him for bad engage because E has two dashes. Your ultimate counters his ultimate.
[3] The mobility that Rakkan has makes it especially difficult to capture with our Q
[2] if he tries to hook you, you can just E away to dodge him.
[2] keep in mind that if he times his push (E) correctly, he can cancel your W.
[2] Going even in laning phase would be the safest bet, since you are a lot squishier than him.
